def run(Ef,Tk):

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*T**3
            +(p[4]+p[5]*T)*eps**p[9]
            +(p[6]+p[7]*T)/eps
            +p[8]*eps*T)
